**1. Introduction & Scope**

This section of the Asset Register covers all mechanical systems installed at Greenview Tower, including chillers, cooling towers, pumps, AHUs, FCUs, and the associated heat rejection and distribution equipment. The register is maintained by the Facility Management team and is updated on an event basis (installation, replacement, major overhaul, or decommissioning). Equipment is identified by a unique Asset ID, which is referenced in all maintenance logs, work orders, and vendor reports.

**Note on Status:** The status of each asset is recorded as of the last update date. "Active" indicates the equipment is in service and available for duty. "Standby" indicates the equipment is installed, operational, and available for use but is not the primary duty unit. "Decommissioned" indicates the equipment has been permanently removed from service. "Under Repair" indicates a temporary status for equipment that is out of service for maintenance.

---

The chilled water plant is divided into four primary systems (CH-1 to CH-4). CH-1 and CH-2 are located in Plant Room 1 (Basement 1). CH-3 and CH-4 are located in Plant Room 2 (Basement 2). **Prepared By:** Horizon Facilities (Facility Management Team)
**Location:** Greenview Tower, Plot 42, Sector 18, Gurugram, Haryana

---

**1. Introduction & Scope**

This section of the Asset Register covers all mechanical systems installed at Greenview Tower, including chillers, cooling towers, pumps, AHUs, FCUs, and the associated heat rejection and distribution equipment. The register is maintained by the Facility Management team and is updated on an event basis (installation, replacement, major overhaul, or decommissioning). Equipment is identified by a unique Asset ID, which is referenced in all maintenance logs, work orders, and vendor reports.

**Note on Status:** The status of each asset is recorded as of the last update date. "Active" indicates the equipment is in service and available for duty. "Standby" indicates the equipment is installed, operational, and available for use but is not the primary duty unit. "Decommissioned" indicates the equipment has been permanently removed from service. "Under Repair" indicates a temporary status for equipment that is out of service for maintenance.

---

**2. Chiller Plant**

The chilled water plant is divided into four primary systems (CH-1 to CH-4). CH-1 and CH-2 are located in Plant Room 1 (Basement 1). CH-3 and CH-4 are located in Plant Room 2 (Basement 2).
